about: Coach mode: a game against the app's own computer, chosen on the New Game sheet, with a note on any move, a hint, a takeback and the engine's view on request, saved with its notes and opened in Review with them - and no coach control on a game between two people, on the Online sheet, or on a computer game started with it off. Graded by gate 170 (TC-R235a..j) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568, after the game is played. NOT COVERED: a live online game is never entered (the harness has no second player), so the guard there is read on the Online sheet and its sign-in screen only; the quality of the engine's move; the keyboard of a real phone over the note sheet; his phone. SINCE HIS DESK ANSWERS OF 19 NOV (q10, q12, q14; US-R178, TC-R252): the switch is a full-width row of its own under White and Black and the sheet still fits 320x568 (TC-R252a); the engine's view is a card floating over the board and nothing else moves (TC-R252b); saved coach games with their notes follow the account to a second device (TC-R252c, two stubbed devices on one in-memory account at kunal761 only; nothing reaches Firebase).

breaks.name: guard-dropped
breaks.why: coach mode no longer asks who the opponent is: a Pass & Play game started with the switch still on gets the note row and the engine's view, and is saved as a coach game

breaks.name: notes-not-saved
breaks.why: the notes are kept on the screen during the game but never written into the saved game, so the store and Review have none

breaks.name: engine-unasked
breaks.why: the engine's view runs by itself on every move of a coach game instead of only when it is asked for

breaks.name: row-beside-the-colours
breaks.why: q10 undone: Coach mode is back as a third button in the White and Black row instead of a full-width row of its own

breaks.name: engine-in-the-status-line
breaks.why: q12 undone: the engine's view is written into the status line above the board again and no card floats over the board

breaks.name: games-not-synced
breaks.why: q14 undone: ct_coachgames is not one of the synced keys, so saved coach games stay on the device they were played on
